title: My Recurring Locations
content: Hello everyone, I am new here and figured I should make a post summarizing my recurring location dreams. These have been going on for several years now, but they have begun to increase in frequency and I am fascinated by them. The dreams are always structured like this: - I wake up in a recurring location that has landmarks, and sometimes I get to explore other areas. - I am never fully lucid, but can occasionally do semi-lucid things like flying. - I am always going somewhere/looking for something/running away from an undefined "someone." - sometimes I am joined by dream versions of my friends and family, sometimes by people I have never met before but consider as my friends. • The Dream Mall: My most common location. It has an estimated 10 levels, but I have only been up to level 3. There is a Chinese restaurant one must pass through in order to reach the other side of the mall, through a narrow walkway along the back of the restaurant. It is black and red, and very dark, and always very busy. There is a TV screen playing old Kung Fu movies for people to watch. It feels very fancy. There is also an infinite frozen yogurt bar that stretches into the distance until it becomes mist. Other places of note include a dark swimming pool room made of concrete, with extremely dim yellow lighting; a vast fancy dining hall that is usually half empty, with a large marble Roman statue of a woman holding a bouquet of flowers; a clothing store that is intensely bright white with only neon orange clothes (I supposedly work here but I'm never on shift); and a hair products and perfume store that smells like a salon and has everything on thin gold and glass shelving units. • The Hotel: Second most common location. A huge seemingly endless hotel with beige walls, a gold and black carpet, and an overall fancy gold and black color scheme. The hallways are tight and narrow and nonsensical. Occasionally I will see staff, who are all butler-type older men, in pristine black and white tuxedos with white bow ties and white gloves. I have never spoken to them but I have seen them busy at work. One of the hallways is open along one long side, and it goes down into a large sloping carpeted ramp at an uncomfortable angle, where I have to scoot down on my back to reach the event hall below. Sometimes the event hall is empty, sometimes there is an artisan market down there. There is also an incredibly cramped Auditorium with an oppressive atmosphere in there. It is a tight circle, and very dark, with red fabric seats that lean so far inwards it feels like gravity is wrong in there, and if there weren't metal safety bars I would probably fall. I don't know why but it has "church vibes" and that's the only way I know how to explain it. I have never seen a presentation in there but it's very tight and almost feels like I'm being Watched. • Bayside: Third most common. It is a city on an ocean bay with a long dock and old brick and wooden buildings with white trim that are built crammed and piled on top of each other, almost leaning into the sea. There is a spiraling hotel here as well, though it is abandoned, and instead of having elevators there is just a very tight spiral staircase/ladder just big enough for one person. Every floor is circular and small, dusty, with gray wood floors and red and green musty furniture. The walls are rotting from the ocean spray. Bayside itself, however, is a crowded bustling town. It is only the hotel that is abandoned. There is also an aquarium that consists of one gigantic white box of a room with a very high ceiling, with a thin wooden walkway along the edge of the room. The center of the room is bright blue pool water that reflects against the ceiling and walls. There are bright floaty toys in the water and two gray seals. • The Neighborhood Least common. It's a version of my house and neighborhood that does not exist. In this version, there is an extremely high red brick retaining wall in front of my house, making it elevated on a hill, and a dense jungle of a garden in front. There is also a small patio instead of a porch, just big enough for one chair and a lantern, raised on an even higher brick platform. No safety railing but no one's ever fallen. My family is usually here but they are going about their business and never seem to want to talk. It's usually nighttime. My most recent visit to this location (last night) was the only time I have seen The Neighborhood during the day and it was so bright, like a Fruitiger Aero wallpaper, and there was something like a bullet train+roller coaster vehicle that has been added. I don't know where it goes or why it isn't there at night. • Basement World (Honorable mention) The Basement World is weird because it's usually connected to any one of the previous places. It can be reached at any time by walking around and finding a door identical to my real world basement door. Going down the long, rickety wooden steps leads to an unfinished basement labyrinth with concrete floors and walls, dirt and wooden beam ceilings, endless halls of cardboard storage boxes, and an oppressive ominous feeling. I hate it there because once I enter I can never leave, and I have pretty bad nyctophobia, and it's usually scary dark in there. However, many times when I have started to get scared of how dark it is, a golden retriever named Masha joins me and leads me to a room where her owner is. He is a teenage boy in a black hoodie who my subconscious regards as an old friend even though I have never met this dude before. We never speak directly but Masha is his dog and she always guides me when I'm scared. She only ever appears in the Basement World. That's all I've got so far, I'd be happy to discuss these locations further, I'm extremely fascinated by them and I don't understand why I keep visiting them or why they're so detailed. I would love to learn how to visit them by choice, because there's so much left unexplored and it would be a fun thing to look forward to when I go to sleep. :) If you've made it this far thank you so much for reading and have a cookie 🍪🙏🏻
